polozky.nadpis: Why Team Depth Is Becoming Surveyors’ Best Defense Against Project Delays
polozky.perex: Every firm knows the feeling. A job is booked, the client expects a field crew.
polozky.telo: Every firm knows the feeling. A job is booked, the client expects a field crew. Then one surveyor calls in sick. Another is stuck finishing a job that ran long. The one person registered to sign off on the report is on leave. Nothing about the work itself has changed, but the schedule slips anyway. The firm’s capacity to deliver was resting on a handful of specific people, not a team that could absorb the gap. Depth Isn’t the Same as Headcount It’s easy to conflate “team depth” with simply having more staff, but the two aren’t the same thing.
